checks.allowedAI: What leaves this computerFoundry itself sends nothing over the network: e-mails are drafts the person sends, chat messages are drafts they paste.Through a coding agent: what Foundry's tools return goes to that agent's AI provider under the person's agreement with them. Foundry returns counts, step names and practice results; a live list is shown in the browser, and the agent sees only how many items it has.AI builders: Mercury (Inception) only if Allowed AI says so and a key is saved; Claude Haiku (Anthropic) only if Foundry is started with --builder haiku and Allowed AI says so. Allowed AI here: none (set by your organisation).
